summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PracticePal AI Mock Interview App. Backend API structure works correctly, but question generation has JSON parsing issues. Frontend UI is well-designed and functional, but integration fails due to backend errors.

critical_bugs.issue: Question generation fails with 'Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)' error when parsing Groq API response
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks entire interview setup flow - users cannot generate questions
critical_bugs.root_cause: Backend tries to parse Groq API response directly as JSON, but response is wrapped in choices[0].message.content structure

critical_bugs.issue: Audio processing fails due to invalid WebM data format in tests
critical_bugs.impact: Cannot process interview audio for feedback generation
critical_bugs.root_cause: Test uses mock base64 data that's not valid WebM format, causing ffmpeg conversion to fail
